label: Send Email
description: Sends an email from a mailbox over SMTP, works with any mail provider; set replyToMessageId to reply inside an existing thread.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: Needs the connection's SMTP server filled.

inputs.name: replyToMessageId
inputs.description: Message-ID being answered (e.g. ReceiveEmail's messageId); sets the reply headers so clients thread it.

outputs.name: messageId
outputs.description: Message-ID header of the sent mail.
